title: Login stops every time at trust-device · stay-signed-in · upsell screens
symptom: On every login the agent asks the user the same question at trust this device (don't ask again) · stay signed in · passkey or contact upsell screens. In remote-control the user cannot see the screen, so the flow breaks
cause: No interstitial login screen policy is saved (every key is ask). Screens differ per provider, so there is no auto-click code; the agent identifies the screen type and presses according to the saved policy
fix: launch_cli.py cred policy set --name <name> --key trust_device --value always
launch_cli.py cred policy set --key skip_nags --value always
If login_policy in the web type --cred · app type --cred result is always · never, press without asking. If ask, ask with a capture and save 'this account / all sites / just once' via cred policy set
Do not press screens you cannot identify — send a capture to the conversation and ask. Never disable 2FA or change account security settings
